checks.name: 해외 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM global_etf WHERE TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE)>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 미국 주식형 순위 합 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM (SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) ASC) + RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC) AS s, TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) AS aum, pd_itm_no FROM global_etf WHERE wu_inv_ast_type='Equity' AND wu_inv_rgn ILIKE '%United States%' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)>0 AND TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE)>0) ORDER BY s, aum DESC, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 삼성전자 편입 ETF 1년 수익률 상위 10
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM etf_constituent c JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' AND e.drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(e.du_er_1y AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.du_er_1y AS DOUBLE) DESC LIMIT 10
